auditor_command: python3 src/auditor.py input/protocol.json input/fixture.json input/oracle_fixture.json raw/candidate.json audit/audit.json

decision_rules.HOLD: audit integrity, source identification, matched hard gates, or candidate truth-label isolation fails.
decision_rules.H_FAIL_SCOPED: audit passes but one or more preregistered H_PASS conditions fail; report exact failed comparator/gate without rerun.
decision_rules.H_PASS_SCOPED: source classifier accuracy >=0.70; DECOMPOSED correctness is within 0.01 of both TOTAL_UNCERTAINTY and DECISION_VALUE; mean cost is at least 0.02 lower than both; DECOMPOSED returns UNKNOWN on correlated-duplicate and misspecified-decomposition controls.
decision_rules.METHOD_PASS_SCOPED: independent auditor reconstructs all 4,800 rows, all exact hard gates match, source-estimator dependence/epoch/label/cost mutation controls reject 4/4, and no truth labels appear in candidate output.
